61         self,
62         client: Client | None = None,
63         client_args: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
64         **model_config: Unpack[OpenAIConfig],
65     ) -> None:
66         """Initialize provider instance.
67 
68         Args:
69             client: Pre-configured OpenAI-compatible client to reuse across requests.
70                 When provided, this client will be reused for all requests and will NOT be closed
71                 by the model. The caller is responsible for managing the client lifecycle.
72                 This is useful for:
73                 - Injecting custom client wrappers (e.g., GuardrailsAsyncOpenAI)
74                 - Reusing connection pools within a single event loop/worker
75                 - Centralizing observability, retries, and networking policy
76                 - Pointing to custom model gateways
77                 Note: The client should not be shared across different asyncio event loops.
78             client_args: Arguments for the OpenAI client (legacy approach).
79                 For a complete list of supported arguments, see https://pypi.org/project/openai/.

86         self.config = dict(model_config)
87

89         if client is not None and client_args is not None and len(client_args) > 0:
90             raise ValueError("Only one of 'client' or 'client_args' should be provided, not both.")

92         self._custom_client = client

94

116     @classmethod
117     def format_request_message_content(cls, content: ContentBlock, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
118         """Format an OpenAI compatible content block.
119 
120         Args:
121             content: Message content.
122             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
123 
124         Returns:
125             OpenAI compatible content block.
126 
127         Raises:
128             TypeError: If the content block type cannot be converted to an OpenAI-compatible format.
129         """
130         if "document" in content:
131             mime_type = mimetypes.types_map.get(f".{content['document']['format']}", "application/octet-stream")
132             file_data = base64.b64encode(content["document"]["source"]["bytes"]).decode("utf-8")
133             return {
134                 "file": {
135                     "file_data": f"data:{mime_type};base64,{file_data}",
136                     "filename": content["document"]["name"],
137                 },
138                 "type": "file",
139             }
140 
141         if "image" in content:
142             mime_type = mimetypes.types_map.get(f".{content['image']['format']}", "application/octet-stream")
143             image_data = base64.b64encode(content["image"]["source"]["bytes"]).decode("utf-8")
144 
145             return {
146                 "image_url": {
147                     "detail": "auto",
148                     "format": mime_type,
149                     "url": f"data:{mime_type};base64,{image_data}",
150                 },
151                 "type": "image_url",
152             }
153 
154         if "text" in content:
155             return {"text": content["text"], "type": "text"}
156 
157         raise TypeError(f"content_type=<{next(iter(content))}> | unsupported type")
158

204     @classmethod
205     def _split_tool_message_images(cls, tool_message: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any] | None]:
206         """Split a tool message into text-only tool message and optional user message with images.
207 
208         OpenAI API restricts images to user role messages only. This method extracts any image
209         content from a tool message and returns it separately as a user message.
210 
211         Args:
212             tool_message: A formatted tool message that may contain images.
213 
214         Returns:
215             A tuple of (tool_message_without_images, user_message_with_images_or_None).
216         """
217         if tool_message.get("role") != "tool":
218             return tool_message, None
219 
220         content = tool_message.get("content", [])
221         if not isinstance(content, list):
222             return tool_message, None
223 
224         # Separate image and non-image content
225         text_content = []
226         image_content = []
227 
228         for item in content:
229             if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "image_url":
230                 image_content.append(item)
231             else:
232                 text_content.append(item)
233 
234         # If no images found, return original message
235         if not image_content:
236             return tool_message, None
237 
238         # Let the user know that we are modifying the messages for OpenAI compatibility
239         logger.warning(
240             "tool_call_id=<%s> | Moving image from tool message to a new user message for OpenAI compatibility",
241             tool_message["tool_call_id"],
242         )
243 
244         # Append a message to the text content to inform the model about the upcoming image
245         text_content.append(
246             {
247                 "type": "text",
248                 "text": (
249                     "Tool successfully returned an image. The image is being provided in the following user message."
250                 ),
251             }
252         )
253 
254         # Create the clean tool message with the updated text content
255         tool_message_clean = {
256             "role": "tool",
257             "tool_call_id": tool_message["tool_call_id"],
258             "content": text_content,
259         }
260 
261         # Create user message with only images
262         user_message_with_images = {"role": "user", "content": image_content}
263 
264         return tool_message_clean, user_message_with_images
265 
266     @classmethod
267     def _format_request_tool_choice(cls, tool_choice: ToolChoice | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
268         """Format a tool choice for OpenAI compatibility.
269 
270         Args:
271             tool_choice: Tool choice configuration in Bedrock format.
272 
273         Returns:
274             OpenAI compatible tool choice format.
275         """
276         if not tool_choice:
277             return {}
278 
279         match tool_choice:
280             case {"auto": _}:
281                 return {"tool_choice": "auto"}  # OpenAI SDK doesn't define constants for these values
282             case {"any": _}:
283                 return {"tool_choice": "required"}
284             case {"tool": {"name": tool_name}}:
285                 return {"tool_choice": {"type": "function", "function": {"name": tool_name}}}
286             case _:
287                 # This should not happen with proper typing, but handle gracefully
288                 return {"tool_choice": "auto"}

319     @classmethod
320     def _format_regular_messages(cls, messages: Messages, **kwargs: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
321         """Format regular messages for OpenAI-compatible providers.
322 
323         Args:
324             messages: List of message objects to be processed by the model.
325             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
326 
327         Returns:
328             List of formatted messages.
329         """
330         formatted_messages = []
331 
332         for message in messages:
333             contents = message["content"]
334 
335             # Check for reasoningContent and warn user
336             if any("reasoningContent" in content for content in contents):
337                 logger.warning(
338                     "reasoningContent is not supported in multi-turn conversations with the Chat Completions API."
339                 )
340 
341             formatted_contents = [
342                 cls.format_request_message_content(content)
343                 for content in contents
344                 if not any(block_type in content for block_type in ["toolResult", "toolUse", "reasoningContent"])
345             ]
346             formatted_tool_calls = [
347                 cls.format_request_message_tool_call(content["toolUse"]) for content in contents if "toolUse" in content
348             ]
349             formatted_tool_messages = [
350                 cls.format_request_tool_message(content["toolResult"])
351                 for content in contents
352                 if "toolResult" in content
353             ]
354 
355             formatted_message = {
356                 "role": message["role"],
357                 "content": formatted_contents,
358                 **({"tool_calls": formatted_tool_calls} if formatted_tool_calls else {}),
359             }
360             formatted_messages.append(formatted_message)
361 
362             # Process tool messages to extract images into separate user messages
363             # OpenAI API requires images to be in user role messages only
364             for tool_msg in formatted_tool_messages:
365                 tool_msg_clean, user_msg_with_images = cls._split_tool_message_images(tool_msg)
366                 formatted_messages.append(tool_msg_clean)
367                 if user_msg_with_images:
368                     formatted_messages.append(user_msg_with_images)
369 
370         return formatted_messages

379         **kwargs: Any,

398         self,
399         messages: Messages,
400         tool_specs: list[ToolSpec] | None = None,
401         system_prompt: str | None = None,
402         tool_choice: ToolChoice | None = None,
403         *,
404         system_prompt_content: list[SystemContentBlock] | None = None,
405         **kwargs: Any,
406     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
407         """Format an OpenAI compatible chat streaming request.
408 
409         Args:
410             messages: List of message objects to be processed by the model.

412             system_prompt: System prompt to provide context to the model.
413             tool_choice: Selection strategy for tool invocation.
414             system_prompt_content: System prompt content blocks to provide context to the model.
415             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.

417         Returns:
418             An OpenAI compatible chat streaming request.

421             TypeError: If a message contains a content block type that cannot be converted to an OpenAI-compatible

425             "messages": self.format_request_messages(

429             "stream": True,

446     def format_chunk(self, event: dict[str, Any], **kwargs: Any) -> StreamEvent:
447         """Format an OpenAI response event into a standardized message chunk.
448 
449         Args:
450             event: A response event from the OpenAI compatible model.
451             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
452 
453         Returns:
454             The formatted chunk.
455 
456         Raises:
457             RuntimeError: If chunk_type is not recognized.
458                 This error should never be encountered as chunk_type is controlled in the stream method.
459         """
460         match event["chunk_type"]:
461             case "message_start":
462                 return {"messageStart": {"role": "assistant"}}
463 
464             case "content_start":
465                 if event["data_type"] == "tool":
466                     return {
467                         "contentBlockStart": {
468                             "start": {
469                                 "toolUse": {
470                                     "name": event["data"].function.name,
471                                     "toolUseId": event["data"].id,
472                                 }
473                             }
474                         }
475                     }
476 
477                 return {"contentBlockStart": {"start": {}}}
478 
479             case "content_delta":
480                 if event["data_type"] == "tool":
481                     return {
482                         "contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"toolUse": {"input": event["data"].function.arguments or ""}}}
483                     }
484 
485                 if event["data_type"] == "reasoning_content":
486                     return {"contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"reasoningContent": {"text": event["data"]}}}}
487 
488                 return {"contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"text": event["data"]}}}
489 
490             case "content_stop":
491                 return {"contentBlockStop": {}}
492 
493             case "message_stop":
494                 match event["data"]:
495                     case "tool_calls":
496                         return {"messageStop": {"stopReason": "tool_use"}}
497                     case "length":
498                         return {"messageStop": {"stopReason": "max_tokens"}}
499                     case _:
500                         return {"messageStop": {"stopReason": "end_turn"}}
501 
502             case "metadata":
503                 return {
504                     "metadata": {
505                         "usage": {
506                             "inputTokens": event["data"].prompt_tokens,
507                             "outputTokens": event["data"].completion_tokens,
508                             "totalTokens": event["data"].total_tokens,
509                         },
510                         "metrics": {
511                             "latencyMs": 0,  # TODO
512                         },
513                     },
514                 }
515 
516             case _:
517                 raise RuntimeError(f"chunk_type=<{event['chunk_type']} | unknown type")
518 
519     @asynccontextmanager
520     async def _get_client(self) -> AsyncIterator[Any]:
521         """Get an OpenAI client for making requests.
522 
523         This context manager handles client lifecycle management:
524         - If an injected client was provided during initialization, it yields that client
525           without closing it (caller manages lifecycle).
526         - Otherwise, creates a new AsyncOpenAI client from client_args and automatically
527           closes it when the context exits.
528 
529         Note: We create a new client per request to avoid connection sharing in the underlying
530         httpx client, as the asyncio event loop does not allow connections to be shared.
531         For more details, see https://github.com/encode/httpx/discussions/2959.
532 
533         Yields:
534             Client: An OpenAI-compatible client instance.
535         """
536         if self._custom_client is not None:
537             # Use the injected client (caller manages lifecycle)
538             yield self._custom_client
539         else:
540             # Create a new client from client_args
541             # We initialize an OpenAI context on every request so as to avoid connection sharing in the underlying
542             # httpx client. The asyncio event loop does not allow connections to be shared. For more details, please
543             # refer to https://github.com/encode/httpx/discussions/2959.
544             async with openai.AsyncOpenAI(**self.client_args) as client:
545                 yield client

547     @override
548     async def stream(
549         self,
550         messages: Messages,
551         tool_specs: list[ToolSpec] | None = None,
552         system_prompt: str | None = None,
553         *,
554         tool_choice: ToolChoice | None = None,
555         **kwargs: Any,
556     ) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamEvent, None]:
557         """Stream conversation with the OpenAI model.
558 
559         Args:
560             messages: List of message objects to be processed by the model.
561             tool_specs: List of tool specifications to make available to the model.
562             system_prompt: System prompt to provide context to the model.
563             tool_choice: Selection strategy for tool invocation.
564             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
565 
566         Yields:
567             Formatted message chunks from the model.
568 
569         Raises:
570             ContextWindowOverflowException: If the input exceeds the model's context window.
571             ModelThrottledException: If the request is throttled by OpenAI (rate limits).
572         """
573         logger.debug("formatting request")
574         request = self.format_request(messages, tool_specs, system_prompt, tool_choice)
575         logger.debug("formatted request=<%s>", request)
576 
577         logger.debug("invoking model")
578 
579         # We initialize an OpenAI context on every request so as to avoid connection sharing in the underlying httpx
580         # client. The asyncio event loop does not allow connections to be shared. For more details, please refer to
581         # https://github.com/encode/httpx/discussions/2959.
582         async with self._get_client() as client:
583             try:
584                 response = await client.chat.completions.create(**request)
585             except openai.BadRequestError as e:
586                 # Check if this is a context length exceeded error
587                 if hasattr(e, "code") and e.code == "context_length_exceeded":
588                     logger.warning("OpenAI threw context window overflow error")
589                     raise ContextWindowOverflowException(str(e)) from e
590                 # Re-raise other BadRequestError exceptions
591                 raise
592             except openai.RateLimitError as e:
593                 # All rate limit errors should be treated as throttling, not context overflow
594                 # Rate limits (including TPM) require waiting/retrying, not context reduction
595                 logger.warning("OpenAI threw rate limit error")
596                 raise ModelThrottledException(str(e)) from e
597 
598             logger.debug("got response from model")
599             yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "message_start"})
600             tool_calls: dict[int, list[Any]] = {}
601             data_type = None
602             finish_reason = None  # Store finish_reason for later use
603             event = None  # Initialize for scope safety
604 
605             async for event in response:
606                 # Defensive: skip events with empty or missing choices
607                 if not getattr(event, "choices", None):
608                     continue
609                 choice = event.choices[0]
610 
611                 if hasattr(choice.delta, "reasoning_content") and choice.delta.reasoning_content:
612                     chunks, data_type = self._stream_switch_content("reasoning_content", data_type)
613                     for chunk in chunks:
614                         yield chunk
615                     yield self.format_chunk(
616                         {
617                             "chunk_type": "content_delta",
618                             "data_type": data_type,
619                             "data": choice.delta.reasoning_content,
620                         }
621                     )
622 
623                 if choice.delta.content:
624                     chunks, data_type = self._stream_switch_content("text", data_type)
625                     for chunk in chunks:
626                         yield chunk
627                     yield self.format_chunk(
628                         {"chunk_type": "content_delta", "data_type": data_type, "data": choice.delta.content}
629                     )
630 
631                 for tool_call in choice.delta.tool_calls or []:
632                     tool_calls.setdefault(tool_call.index, []).append(tool_call)
633 
634                 if choice.finish_reason:
635                     finish_reason = choice.finish_reason  # Store for use outside loop
636                     if data_type:
637                         yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "content_stop", "data_type": data_type})
638                     break
639 
640             for tool_deltas in tool_calls.values():
641                 yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "content_start", "data_type": "tool", "data": tool_deltas[0]})
642 
643                 for tool_delta in tool_deltas:
644                     yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "content_delta", "data_type": "tool", "data": tool_delta})
645 
646                 yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "content_stop", "data_type": "tool"})
647 
648             yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "message_stop", "data": finish_reason or "end_turn"})
649 
650             # Skip remaining events as we don't have use for anything except the final usage payload
651             async for event in response:
652                 _ = event
653 
654             if event and hasattr(event, "usage") and event.usage:
655                 yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "metadata", "data": event.usage})
656 
657         logger.debug("finished streaming response from model")
658 
659     def _stream_switch_content(self, data_type: str, prev_data_type: str | None) -> tuple[list[StreamEvent], str]:
660         """Handle switching to a new content stream.
661 
662         Args:
663             data_type: The next content data type.
664             prev_data_type: The previous content data type.
665 
666         Returns:
667             Tuple containing:
668             - Stop block for previous content and the start block for the next content.
669             - Next content data type.
670         """
671         chunks = []
672         if data_type != prev_data_type:
673             if prev_data_type is not None:
674                 chunks.append(self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "content_stop", "data_type": prev_data_type}))
675             chunks.append(self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "content_start", "data_type": data_type}))
676 
677         return chunks, data_type

205     def _split_tool_message_images(cls, tool_message: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any] | None]:
206         """Split a tool message into text-only tool message and optional user message with images.
207 
208         OpenAI API restricts images to user role messages only. This method extracts any image
209         content from a tool message and returns it separately as a user message.
210 
211         Args:
212             tool_message: A formatted tool message that may contain images.
213 
214         Returns:
215             A tuple of (tool_message_without_images, user_message_with_images_or_None).
216         """
217         if tool_message.get("role") != "tool":
218             return tool_message, None
219 
220         content = tool_message.get("content", [])
221         if not isinstance(content, list):
222             return tool_message, None
223 
224         # Separate image and non-image content
225         text_content = []
226         image_content = []
227 
228         for item in content:
229             if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "image_url":
230                 image_content.append(item)
231             else:
232                 text_content.append(item)
233 
234         # If no images found, return original message
235         if not image_content:
236             return tool_message, None
237 
238         # Let the user know that we are modifying the messages for OpenAI compatibility
239         logger.warning(
240             "tool_call_id=<%s> | Moving image from tool message to a new user message for OpenAI compatibility",
241             tool_message["tool_call_id"],
242         )
243 
244         # Append a message to the text content to inform the model about the upcoming image
245         text_content.append(
246             {
247                 "type": "text",
248                 "text": (
249                     "Tool successfully returned an image. The image is being provided in the following user message."
250                 ),
251             }
252         )
253 
254         # Create the clean tool message with the updated text content
255         tool_message_clean = {
256             "role": "tool",
257             "tool_call_id": tool_message["tool_call_id"],
258             "content": text_content,
259         }
260 
261         # Create user message with only images
262         user_message_with_images = {"role": "user", "content": image_content}
263 
264         return tool_message_clean, user_message_with_images

519     @asynccontextmanager
520     async def _get_client(self) -> AsyncIterator[Any]:
521         """Get an OpenAI client for making requests.
522 
523         This context manager handles client lifecycle management:
524         - If an injected client was provided during initialization, it yields that client
525           without closing it (caller manages lifecycle).
526         - Otherwise, creates a new AsyncOpenAI client from client_args and automatically
527           closes it when the context exits.
528 
529         Note: We create a new client per request to avoid connection sharing in the underlying
530         httpx client, as the asyncio event loop does not allow connections to be shared.
531         For more details, see https://github.com/encode/httpx/discussions/2959.
532 
533         Yields:
534             Client: An OpenAI-compatible client instance.
535         """
536         if self._custom_client is not None:
537             # Use the injected client (caller manages lifecycle)
538             yield self._custom_client
539         else:
540             # Create a new client from client_args
541             # We initialize an OpenAI context on every request so as to avoid connection sharing in the underlying
542             # httpx client. The asyncio event loop does not allow connections to be shared. For more details, please
543             # refer to https://github.com/encode/httpx/discussions/2959.
544             async with openai.AsyncOpenAI(**self.client_args) as client:
545                 yield client

547     @override
548     async def stream(
549         self,
550         messages: Messages,
551         tool_specs: list[ToolSpec] | None = None,
552         system_prompt: str | None = None,
553         *,
554         tool_choice: ToolChoice | None = None,
555         **kwargs: Any,
556     ) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamEvent, None]:
557         """Stream conversation with the OpenAI model.
558 
559         Args:
560             messages: List of message objects to be processed by the model.
561             tool_specs: List of tool specifications to make available to the model.
562             system_prompt: System prompt to provide context to the model.
563             tool_choice: Selection strategy for tool invocation.
564             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
565 
566         Yields:
567             Formatted message chunks from the model.
568 
569         Raises:
570             ContextWindowOverflowException: If the input exceeds the model's context window.
571             ModelThrottledException: If the request is throttled by OpenAI (rate limits).
572         """
573         logger.debug("formatting request")
574         request = self.format_request(messages, tool_specs, system_prompt, tool_choice)
575         logger.debug("formatted request=<%s>", request)
576 
577         logger.debug("invoking model")
578 
579         # We initialize an OpenAI context on every request so as to avoid connection sharing in the underlying httpx
580         # client. The asyncio event loop does not allow connections to be shared. For more details, please refer to
581         # https://github.com/encode/httpx/discussions/2959.
582         async with self._get_client() as client:
583             try:
584                 response = await client.chat.completions.create(**request)
585             except openai.BadRequestError as e:
586                 # Check if this is a context length exceeded error
587                 if hasattr(e, "code") and e.code == "context_length_exceeded":
588                     logger.warning("OpenAI threw context window overflow error")
589                     raise ContextWindowOverflowException(str(e)) from e
590                 # Re-raise other BadRequestError exceptions
591                 raise
592             except openai.RateLimitError as e:
593                 # All rate limit errors should be treated as throttling, not context overflow
594                 # Rate limits (including TPM) require waiting/retrying, not context reduction
595                 logger.warning("OpenAI threw rate limit error")
596                 raise ModelThrottledException(str(e)) from e
597 
598             logger.debug("got response from model")
599             yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "message_start"})
600             tool_calls: dict[int, list[Any]] = {}
601             data_type = None
602             finish_reason = None  # Store finish_reason for later use
603             event = None  # Initialize for scope safety
604 
605             async for event in response:
606                 # Defensive: skip events with empty or missing choices
607                 if not getattr(event, "choices", None):
608                     continue
609                 choice = event.choices[0]
610 
611                 if hasattr(choice.delta, "reasoning_content") and choice.delta.reasoning_content:
612                     chunks, data_type = self._stream_switch_content("reasoning_content", data_type)
613                     for chunk in chunks:
614                         yield chunk
615                     yield self.format_chunk(
616                         {
617                             "chunk_type": "content_delta",
618                             "data_type": data_type,
619                             "data": choice.delta.reasoning_content,
620                         }
621                     )
622 
623                 if choice.delta.content:
624                     chunks, data_type = self._stream_switch_content("text", data_type)
625                     for chunk in chunks:
626                         yield chunk
627                     yield self.format_chunk(
628                         {"chunk_type": "content_delta", "data_type": data_type, "data": choice.delta.content}
629                     )
630 
631                 for tool_call in choice.delta.tool_calls or []:
632                     tool_calls.setdefault(tool_call.index, []).append(tool_call)
633 
634                 if choice.finish_reason:
635                     finish_reason = choice.finish_reason  # Store for use outside loop
636                     if data_type:
637                         yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "content_stop", "data_type": data_type})
638                     break
639 
640             for tool_deltas in tool_calls.values():
641                 yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "content_start", "data_type": "tool", "data": tool_deltas[0]})
642 
643                 for tool_delta in tool_deltas:
644                     yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "content_delta", "data_type": "tool", "data": tool_delta})
645 
646                 yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "content_stop", "data_type": "tool"})
647 
648             yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "message_stop", "data": finish_reason or "end_turn"})
649 
650             # Skip remaining events as we don't have use for anything except the final usage payload
651             async for event in response:
652                 _ = event
653 
654             if event and hasattr(event, "usage") and event.usage:
655                 yield self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "metadata", "data": event.usage})
656 
657         logger.debug("finished streaming response from model")

659     def _stream_switch_content(self, data_type: str, prev_data_type: str | None) -> tuple[list[StreamEvent], str]:
660         """Handle switching to a new content stream.
661 
662         Args:
663             data_type: The next content data type.
664             prev_data_type: The previous content data type.
665 
666         Returns:
667             Tuple containing:
668             - Stop block for previous content and the start block for the next content.
669             - Next content data type.
670         """

673             if prev_data_type is not None:

675             chunks.append(self.format_chunk({"chunk_type": "content_start", "data_type": data_type}))
